note.question: How can optimized planting schedules support improved crop productivity?
note.overview: This paper studies the optimal seeding policy under rainfall uncertainty in rain-fed agriculture and explore its advantage over commonly used heuristics in practice. The paper's work is in the area of agriculture operations, and we focus on the improvement of farmer’s expected total profit by optimizing planting schedules. We model a farmer’s planting problem under limited planting capacity in a finite-horizon stochastic dynamic program.
